$comment: Copy to .mcp.json in the host repo. The klein-sdlc skills and agents call these servers by these exact names — linear, github, playwright — so the names are not a preference. Linear authenticates in-session via /mcp. GitHub needs GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in the environment and the github-mcp-server binary on PATH; the remote variant at https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ with a bearer header works too.
